plan.summary: DIR-091 recon complete. I READ THE REFERENCE IMAGE, and I am leading with a CONFLICT BETWEEN TWO CERTIFIED DIRECTIVES THAT I WILL NOT SILENTLY BREAK. DIR-091 mandates '4 High-Density Metric Cards (Total Resumes 5, Avg ATS 69% donut gauge, Applications 1, Interview Coach Ready)'. DIR-085 deliberately RETIRED exactly that, and its test pins the retirement with hard assertions: tests/dir085-overview-workspace-mastery.test.mjs:33-36 asserts doesNotMatch for import CubaStatCard, for AtsRadialGauge|ResumeProgressBar|PipelineStepper, for <CubaStatCard, and for the literal strings 'Average ATS Score' and 'Active Resumes', under the comment 'The four full-height stat cards and the cold radial gauge are retired.' So implementing the DIR-091 metric row WILL break DIR-085's pins. That is legitimate supersession - the newest directive wins - but I will supersede those assertions EXPLICITLY, stating which DIR-085 assertions I retire and why, rather than quietly deleting a previous directive's guard. If instead the intent is that the DIR-085 capsules should REMAIN and the metric cards are additive, say so and I will scope accordingly. SECOND: THE SCREENSHOT NUMBERS ARE ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT SPECIFICATION. The reference shows 5 resumes, 69 percent ATS, 1 application, and named documents (Master Resume, Software Engineer Product, Data Analyst Resume, UX Designer Resume) with specific ATS and match counts. The directive simultaneously demands 'zero synthetic data'. Those two cannot both hold literally, so my reading is that the LAYOUT is the specification and the VALUES must come from the real account: resume count from getResumes, ATS from the project's own calculateAtsScore, applications from getStatesOfUser, and status badges (Master/Tailored/Draft) derived from real document state rather than invented. I will NOT hardcode 5 or 69 percent. THIRD: MOST OF THE BOTTOM HALF DOES NOT EXIST YET. My sweep found NO Application Progress chart, NO Top Job Matches list and NO Your Next Steps checklist anywhere in src - the only matches are in DashboardSettings and the marketing pricing page. There is also NO chart component in the codebase (only Form/progress-bar and marketing HomepageSteps) and NO 'Upgrade to Pro' card in CubaAppShell. So area 5 and area 7 are entirely new builds, not refinements. FOURTH: WHAT DOES ALREADY EXIST AND SHOULD BE EXTENDED RATHER THAN REWRITTEN: CubaCandidateHero already loads REAL data (getResumes, getTrackedJobs, getStatesOfUser) with a genuine apiError state and a 4s auto-retry, and already renders CopilotHeroHud plus CubaMetricCapsuleStrip; the toolbar category pills already exist; the resume cards already carry the DIR-086 streamlined action row; the right rail already renders AiCareerBriefing plus the DIR-086 Quick-Pitch; and DashboardJobMatching.jsx exists as a real matching source for the Top Job Matches column. FIFTH - SCALE, STATED PLAINLY BECAUSE IT SHAPES THE PLAN: this directive is seven areas and roughly eight distinct new features across DashboardHomepage.jsx, CubaCandidateShell.jsx and CandidateExecutiveRail.jsx. Across this session the two six-part directives (DIR-088, DIR-090) both came back PARTIAL while the single-focus ones (DIR-089) hit their target. I am therefore proposing an ORDER OF WORK rather than pretending to a single-pass 100 percent, and I will report exactly what landed. PLAN. S1 the header and the 4 metric cards bound to REAL data, with the donut gauge driven by the real average ATS and the DIR-085 supersession declared. S2 the workspace toolbar completed: sort dropdown, Ctrl+K search and the Grid/List toggle - which are also DIR-090's undelivered S3, so this pays down that debt. S3 the resume cards: status badges, ATS and match pills, the four-icon action row and the dashed Create a New Resume card with Create with AI and Upload Resume. S4 the bottom three-column analytics built on real sources - application progress from real applications, Top Job Matches from the existing matching module, and a next-steps checklist derived from real profile completeness. S5 the right rail AI Career Assistant: the three tabs, the four quick-action cards, the interactive prompt input with chips, and Today's Insights. S6 the sidebar Upgrade to Pro card. S7 tests/dir091-candidate-dashboard-reference-mastery.test.mjs plus the full gate suite. HONEST DELIVERY EXPECTATION, DECLARED UP FRONT: I will implement in that order and report precisely which of S1 to S6 landed, rather than letting a green suite imply a 100 percent match. If you would rather I guarantee completion, split this into two directives - header plus metric cards plus toolbar plus cards as one, and the analytics plus rail plus sidebar as the other.
